question: Compare bagging and boosting according to the ML terminology reference.
answer: Bagging and boosting are ensemble methods used in machine learning. [S1] Bagging reduces variance, while boosting reduces bias. [S1] Bagging combines several models to reduce variance, whereas boosting sequentially adds models to correct earlier errors, aiming to reduce bias [S1] [S3] [S4] [S5].
